metadata.source: AGMARKNET via data.gov.in, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
metadata.processing: national -- all 36 states/UTs, 733 districts from the Survey of India district layer (national_districts.py); rows without a usable min/max/modal price, or with min greater than max, are dropped; no value is interpolated or carried forward; a district whose AGMARKNET name doesn't match its Survey of India name is a real, expected fetch failure, recorded per-district, not silently skipped
metadata.resolution: Market (APMC mandi) point records, reported per district/state; no gridded resolution applies.
